description:
List the top ~0.7 sq km areas in an Indian state or district, ranked by building growth, building count, height or price outlook.

Use for "where is building fastest in Karnataka", "fastest-growing areas
near Pune", "tallest neighbourhoods in Goa". Only areas with enough
buildings to measure are ranked, one row per village or locality. A
district is ranked as the area within about 40 km of its centre point,
since district boundaries are not available. Each row gives the place,
its nearest town, the ranked figure, the share of ground built on five
years ago and now, and coordinates for footprint_get_area (which gives
prices). A ranking, not advice.

region.description: An Indian state, union territory or district, e.g. 'Karnataka', 'Goa', 'Pune'.
region.title: Region

sorted_by.description: building_growth: fastest built-area growth over 5 years (the default and the most informative). most_buildings: building count. tallest: average building height. price_outlook: forecast price growth (mostly follows the city trend, so areas in one city tie).
sorted_by.title: Sorted By
